main_subject.wardrobe: A lime-green short-sleeve wrap blouse and matching ankle-length wrap skirt with a closed overlap and modest side tie.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Lying comfortably along the center of a narrow boat, one arm bent near her head and the other relaxed along her side.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a square cinematic aerial travel-editorial still of an adult woman with long dark hair and a pink tropical flower tucked near one ear, lying comfortably along the center of a narrow wooden boat. She wears a lime-green short-sleeve wrap blouse and matching ankle-length wrap skirt with closed overlap and modest side tie. One arm bends near her head while the other rests along her side. Surround the boat with still deep green-blue water and large organically imperfect lily pads. Use a perfect bird's-eye full-body composition, calm balanced spacing, natural water reflections, soft even daylight, subtle 35mm grain, natural green palette, realistic anatomy and fabric folds, and non-HDR tonal range. No identity lock, logos, text, watermark, or body-focused crop.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, identity lock, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, bandeau, high slit, lingerie, fetish styling, logo, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra limbs, AI artifacts
